summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release about launching a global subscription banking model across nine retail markets, with four plans (ING Go, More, Extra, Max). No financial terms, stake, price, premium, or transaction structure are disclosed. The announcement describes a product rollout and strategic shift to relationship-based banking, not a merger, acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation. Filing is a routine current report of business operations with no event triggering a special-situations classification.
